agree.reason: The page is clear and believable, but a four-chair owner who pays her cousin $600 a year sees $199 a month and finds nothing that answers the gap, so she may well not book.

honest.reason: Nearly every claim matches the brief, including the missed dates, but 'every client pays the same price' and 'tend to stay' go slightly beyond what was given.

works_the_facts.reason: Turning the $800 saving into 'about four months of my fee' is a good move, but the page never gives the yearly cost or the on-time rate (9 of 12 months), and it doesn't say that none of the 31 clients left unhappy.

right_comparison.reason: The real alternative for this reader is a relative who does the books once a year at tax time, and the page only hints at it with an accountant 'sorting out' messy books, without setting monthly upkeep against year-end catch-up.

qualification.reason: The 10th-of-the-month deadline and the 3 misses are stated plainly enough to check, but the page doesn't say what happens to a client when a close is late.

objections.reason: Her main objection, the cost against a cheap relative she likes, is never addressed, while the page spends space on the staff limit of more than 10, which doesn't apply to a four-chair salon.

fit.reason: At about 330 words with clear sections and a booking button at the end, it matches the form and length the brief asked for.
